_comment: Pokemon moves you can lend a fighter for one fight with /learn. power is on this engine's scale (targeted moves get x2 for aiming at one spot). effects: a status (paralyzed, asleep, confused, burned, poisoned, frozen, flinched, chilled, soaked) with its chance and how many beats it lasts, or a launch (knocked down, thrown, launched) and its chance. Edit freely; healing moves are deliberately left out. sustainable: true means the move can be held for several pulses (pressing the target back, maybe into the scenery).
